wc.title: Website control
wc.sub: Every website setting in one place. Pick a card to open the page where it lives.
wc.search: Search settings, e.g. logo, cookie, footer
wc.none: No setting matches “{q}”. Try another word.
wc.note: Nothing is moved here. Each card opens the same page you already use.
wc.denied: You may not open any website setting.

shopName.d: The name in the header, footer, invoices and the browser tab.

logo.d: The logo for computer and phone, and its size.

favicon.d: The small square icon in the browser tab.

contact.d: Hotline, WhatsApp, email, address, opening hours and the link preview picture.
contact.k: contact phone hotline whatsapp email address hours share preview

header.d: The announcement bar and the header icons.

menu.d: The links in the shop menu, in your order.

footer.d: Footer boxes, link columns, social and payment marks, copyright line.

look.d: Save the whole shop look, restore it or a named look.
look.k: look theme design restore launch snapshot

layouts.d: Each shop page's sections, their order and where they show.
layouts.k: layout page sections home category product

eye.d: Every part of a shop page that can be shown or hidden, in one list.

text.d: Every word the shop shows, in English and Bengali.

cookie.d: The cookie notice shown to visitors.

appicon.d: The icon when a customer adds the shop to a phone home screen.
appicon.k: home screen icon app phone install

email.d: How the emails the shop sends look.

policies.d: Delivery, returns, privacy and terms pages, in both languages.
policies.k: policy policies returns terms privacy delivery refund

seo.d: Titles, descriptions, redirects and what Google sees.
seo.k: seo google ranking title description redirect sitemap

analytics.d: Visits, where they come from and what they do.

checkout.d: What customers see at checkout and how payment choices show.
checkout.k: checkout payment display bkash nagad cod

delivery.d: Delivery times and notes the shop shows, and holiday mode.
delivery.k: delivery shipping time holiday courier info

categories.d: The order of categories and tags in the shop.
categories.k: category categories tags order collection sort
